changes.before: Thay vì tắt, xin đường mang không nghiêng hộp được không?
changes.after: Thay vì đi đường tắt, anh/chị có thể chỉ cho tôi lối đi để mang hộp đàn mà không phải nghiêng hộp không?
changes.reason: Restore complete natural shortcut comparison and polite route request.

changes.before: Hỏi nơi xem thông tin khi lỡ đổi. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Hỏi nơi kiểm tra thông tin chuyến tàu tiếp theo nếu không kịp chuyển tàu. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.reason: Clarify that missed connection refers to train transfer, not an unspecified change.

changes.before: Gumuhit nang dahan-dahan. Paumanhin.
changes.after: Maglaan po kayo ng oras sa pagguhit. Mauuna na po ako.
changes.reason: 失礼します is staff taking leave, not an apology; ゆっくり invites unhurried drawing.

changes.before: आराम से बनाएँ। क्षमा करें।
changes.after: आराम से चित्र बनाइए। अब मैं चलता हूँ।
changes.reason: 失礼します here marks staff departure rather than asking forgiveness.

changes.before: আরামে আঁকুন। মাফ করবেন।
changes.after: আরাম করে আঁকুন। তাহলে আমি আসি।
changes.reason: 失礼します here is a leave-taking expression, not asking forgiveness.

changes.before: Bagian tutup mulut dan bekukan ini?
changes.after: Bagian yang bertuliskan “tutup mulut kantong lalu simpan di freezer” ini, ya?
changes.reason: Specify bag opening; tutup mulut alone instead means closing a human mouth.

changes.before: Năm giờ, toa ba số mười hai. Tôi cất túi vé trong cặp.
changes.after: Năm giờ, toa ba, ghế số mười hai nhỉ. Tôi sẽ cất vé vào ngăn đựng vé trong túi.
changes.reason: Preserve putting the ticket into its holder inside the bag; old phrasing stores the holder instead.

changes.before: Jalan beraspal setelah bunga terus ke pintu utara. Keluar langsung parkiran.
changes.after: Jalan yang diperkeras setelah petak bunga berlanjut sampai pintu keluar utara. Di luar pintu keluar itu ada tempat parkir.
changes.reason: 舗装路 says paved path without specifying asphalt; preserve route and exit relationship.

changes.before: No stairs on the west path. Follow the pond and turn at the bench before the red fence.
changes.after: No stairs on the west path. Follow the pond and turn back at the bench before the red fence.
changes.reason: 折り返す specifically requires turning back, not taking a turn onto another route.

changes.before: Narito ang abiso. Ako mismo ang dumating para kunin ang kahong inihatid ngayon.
changes.after: Opo, nilagyan ko ng kadena at kandado. Pagbalik ko, putol na ang kadena at wala na ang bisikleta.
changes.reason: Replace unrelated parcel-collection collision with locked bicycle and cut-chain discovery.

changes.before: Xin dây làm tay cầm cho hộp để mang đi bộ. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Mô tả xe màu xanh lá, có giỏ phía trước và nhãn dán màu vàng ở chắn bùn phía sau. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.reason: Replace unrelated box-carrying hint with the bicycle features required by Japanese task.

changes.before: Oo, tatlo kaming pamilya. May mapaglalatagan ng sapin?
changes.after: Opo, tatlo kami sa pamilya. May lugar ba kung saan puwedeng maglatag ng sapin?
changes.reason: tatlo kaming pamilya can mean three families; Japanese specifies three family members.

changes.before: Naiintindihan. Kahit may pumunta sa gripo, may isang matandang maiiwan.
changes.after: Naiintindihan. Kahit may pumunta sa gripo, may isang nasa hustong gulang na maiiwan.
changes.reason: 大人 is an adult, not necessarily an elderly person as matanda can imply.

changes.before: बदलने में भी मदद करूँगा। पहले बाँह जाँचूँगा। नमस्कार।
changes.after: कपड़े बदलने में भी मदद करूँगा। पहले आपकी बाँह जाँचता हूँ, कृपया अनुमति दें।
changes.reason: 失礼します here politely precedes arm examination; nurse remains with patient rather than departing.

changes.before: বদলাতেও সাহায্য। আগে হাত দেখি। নমস্কার।
changes.after: পোশাক বদলাতেও সাহায্য করব। আগে আপনার হাত পরীক্ষা করি, অনুমতি দিন।
changes.reason: 失礼します here politely precedes arm examination; nurse remains with patient rather than departing.

changes.before: फेर्न पनि सघाउँछु। पहिले हात जाँच्छु। नमस्कार।
changes.after: लुगा फेर्न पनि सघाउँछु। पहिले तपाईंको हात जाँच्छु, अनुमति दिनुहोस्।
changes.reason: 失礼します here politely precedes arm examination; nurse remains with patient rather than departing.

changes.before: 也会帮您换衣。先查手臂。失陪了。
changes.after: 也会帮您换衣。先让我检查一下手臂，打扰了。
changes.reason: 失礼します here politely precedes arm examination; nurse remains with patient rather than departing.

changes.before: 也會幫您換衣。先查手臂。失陪了。
changes.after: 也會幫您換衣。先讓我檢查一下手臂，打擾了。
changes.reason: 失礼します here politely precedes arm examination; nurse remains with patient rather than departing.

changes.before: จะช่วยเปลี่ยนด้วย ก่อนดูแขนค่ะ ขอตัว
changes.after: จะช่วยเปลี่ยนเสื้อด้วยค่ะ ก่อนอื่นขออนุญาตตรวจแขนก่อนนะคะ
changes.reason: 失礼します here politely precedes arm examination; nurse remains with patient rather than departing.

changes.before: ជួយប្តូរដែរ។ សិនពិនិត្យដៃ។ សុំលាសិន។
changes.after: ខ្ញុំនឹងជួយប្តូរអាវដែរ។ ជាដំបូង សូមអនុញ្ញាតឱ្យខ្ញុំពិនិត្យដៃសិន។
changes.reason: 失礼します here politely precedes arm examination; nurse remains with patient rather than departing.

changes.before: งั้นซื้อแค่น้ำ เบนโตะถึงแล้วค่ะ
changes.after: ถ้าอย่างนั้นจะซื้อแค่เครื่องดื่มค่ะ ส่วนข้าวกล่องจะซื้อหลังถึงปลายทางแล้ว
changes.reason: Preserve postponing boxed-meal purchase until reaching destination; old wording says bento arrived.

changes.before: Usok mula sa bintana. May dalawa sa daan pero hindi ko nakita ang ginagawa.
changes.after: Mula sa bintana, nakakita ako ng usok. May dalawang tao sa kalsada, pero hindi ko nakita kung ano ang ginagawa nila.
changes.reason: Clarify window as witness viewpoint, not an asserted source of the smoke.
